name: OpenWeatherMap

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude (use with lon instead of q)

params.name: units
params.description: metric for Celsius, imperial for Fahrenheit

docsDigest: OpenWeatherMap data 2.5: current weather (/weather) and 5 day / 3 hour forecast (/forecast). Read only. Auth: your API key is sent as the appid query parameter. Identify the place with q=City,CC or with lat and lon. Set units=metric for Celsius. The free tier is rate limited and a new key can take a little while to activate.
notes: Keyless template. Add your OpenWeatherMap API key locally in Skales (Settings, API Connector) and confirm the base host. Verify the base URL and endpoints against your plan; this template is a starting point, not a guarantee.
